value.body:
scratch/design.md item 22 changed, read it again before planning: queueing belongs to the machine launcher ("as soon as there is room, run this"); the experiment launcher hands each new run down once, queued, and no later pass is needed to start it. Room is the machine side's (pools, on-demand machine count, slots); the experiment keeps only a dollar limit, checked at hand-down by reservation. ExperimentState gives every run one status — queued, running, finished, failed — merging stored runs with the launcher's records, and the pass reads only that.
